task: Unify the vanish-while-dragging behavior across all three sliders: drawer chrome goes fully transparent, active slider field stays at 80% opacity (was: margin had a separate 50%-opacity-on-whole-shell special case that didn't apply to font size at all, and non-active fields dimmed to 10% instead of fully disappearing)

public/controller/start-app.js.summary: beginSliderAdjustment/endSliderAdjustment now also toggle .is-adjusting-slider-shell on the closest .viewDrawerShell, in addition to the existing .is-adjusting-slider (closest viewDrawerBody/settingsCard/settingsDetail) and .is-active-slider-field (the range-field itself).

public/styles/settings.css.summary: Removed the old margin-only 'html.is-adjusting-display-margin .viewDrawer.is-open .viewDrawerShell { opacity: 0.5 }' special case. Added '.viewDrawerShell.is-adjusting-slider-shell' which makes the shell's background/border/box-shadow (not opacity, which would also dim the active slider since opacity affects the whole element and descendants as one unit) fully transparent -- applies to both Text size and Margins now. Changed the sibling-fade opacity from 0.1 to 0 (fully invisible) and the active field's opacity from unset (1) to 0.8, per the user's ask: background 100% transparent, active slider ~80% opaque.

test/public/style.test.js.summary: Replaced the removed margin-only shell-opacity assertions with assertions for the new unified .is-adjusting-slider-shell transparency and the 0/0.8 opacity split.
